messages:
julia-partners: Quick thread: NovaWeights wants to be listed in the Redwood marketplace and offered to SIs for on-prem bundles. They asked for permissive redistribution and a "Redwood Verified" provenance badge. What minimal artifacts + legal hooks do we need to accept them?

omar-ops: Operational minimums: canonical model card, build SBOM, signed artifact manifest (sha256 + signature), export classification (ECCN or self-attest), and a small eval set for safety/perf. Also a sample quantized artifact or permission to quantize.

becky-legal: Flag: their current license forbids redistribution. For SI/on-prem we need a reseller addendum that grants redistribution rights, includes indemnity carve-outs, payment terms, and an export compliance clause. I'll prepare a short addendum template if we get the base license PDF.

nate-engineering: Engineering note: their tokenizer is slightly nonstandard and streaming breaks on our SDK. We'll need the tokenizer spec and a small shim. Also request a quantized model (q4_0 or equivalent) or written permission to run our quantizer. Perf targets: p50 <50ms, p95 <250ms on our 1xA100 baseline (seq=512).

carlos-infra: For SI bundles we require a pinned provenance signature we can verify. Preferred: onboarding HSM key rotation. Acceptable fallback: PGP-signed manifest with published fingerprint. Manifest must list each artifact and sha256. Example minimal manifest: 
```
manifest_v:1
artifacts:[weights.tar.gz:sha256=<hex>,tokenizer.json:sha256=<hex>]
signature:<pgp-or-hsm-b64>
```

julia-partners: Timeline ask from Nova: listed in marketplace in ~5 weeks, SI bundles available in ~7 weeks, joint announcement week 9. Are those feasible?

omar-ops: 5 weeks doable IF we get signed artifacts and quant by EOW. Ops will run perf/quant tests in week 1.

becky-legal: I can get a reseller addendum draft in 72 hours once I have the license. Must sign before any reseller distribution or announcement.

nate-engineering: I'll build the SDK shim and quant bench. If provider disallows quantizing we'll surface fp16-hosted only and re-evaluate pricing.

carlos-infra: I'll stub a manifest validator script and HSM-onboarding checklist. If the provider declines HSM, expect +10 business days for manual verification.

onboard-bot: created partner-onboard ticket #PW-1409 (owner: julia-partners)

julia-partners: Action items: 1) Becky to draft reseller addendum; 2) Julia to request license + signed manifest + quant artifact from ops@novaweights.ai; 3) Nate to prep shim and perf bench; 4) Carlos to prepare validator. Check-in Friday. Tag #partnerships if blockers. Thanks! :handshake:
